sources.document: ANA presentó diagnóstico para elaboración de Plan de Gestión de las Cuencas de Tumbes
admissible_claims: ANA treats the Tumbes, Zarumilla, Bocapan, Quebrada Seca and Quebrada Fernandez systems as separately named water-resource-management basins or drainage systems
Bocapan is not a synonym for Rio Tumbes or Rio Zarumilla
forbidden_inferences: the ANA management diagnostic is an event footprint
the named systems share one surface catchment
the source proves activation of a specific Zorritos ravine in 2017 or 2023
the source supplies hydraulic capacity or an IRFEN threshold

Casitas-Bocapan is studied separately from the Zarumilla system
forbidden_inferences: water-stress assessment is flood-event evidence
the study supplies a reproducible basin polygon for IRFEN
the source verifies activation during any historical El Nino window
the source supplies an operational threshold

sources.document: TUMBES - Tumbes - Contralmirante Villar - Zarumilla, etc.: Precipitaciones (Informe de Emergencia 78)

the event window is positive territorial evidence but requires child-ravine attribution before mechanism claims
forbidden_inferences: province-level impact identifies which Zorritos ravine activated
the report supplies an exact event footprint or basin polygon
absence of a named ravine in the report is a negative control

forbidden_inferences: Zorritos district impact proves activation of Bocapan-Casitas or any other named ravine
housing damage locations define hydrologic geometry
the event supplies an IRFEN rainfall threshold
